{/* Header */}

📚 NOTESHARE

A UL Students File Sharing Project

{/* Project Overview */}

Project Overview

NOTESHARE is a prototype web-based platform designed for college students to share and access study materials. The platform ensures verified, school-specific access and reliable file sharing. With a distributed backend and load balancing, the system provides smooth performance even during high demand.

{/* Features */}

Core Features

  • ✅ User Accounts with School Email Verification: Only students with official emails can join.
  • ✅ Upload & Download Notes: Share study notes, guides, and other resources.
  • ✅ Search by Course Number: Quickly find materials by course code or class name.
  • ✅ Ratings & Feedback System: Rate and review files to highlight the most useful resources.
  • ✅ Group Feature: Create and join class-based groups with recommended files.
{/* Tech Stack */}

Technology Stack

Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript (React for prototype)
Backend: PHP + MongoDB/Relational Database
System: Distributed file-sharing system with load balancing

{/* Call to Action */}

🚀 Get Started

Join the platform today and start sharing knowledge with your classmates.

{/* Footer */}

© {new Date().getFullYear()} NOTESHARE – A UL Students File Sharing Project
